questions.question: What does God promise about Jerusalem in Zechariah 8?
options: He will scatter all of the people abroad among the many nations
He will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem, the faithful city
He will hand the whole city over entirely to all of its enemies
He will leave the holy temple in ruins forever and ever and ever
questions.answer: He will return to Zion and dwell in Jerusalem, the faithful city

questions.question: What scene of peace does Zechariah 8 describe?
options: Old men and women sitting in the streets, and boys and girls playing in them
Great armies of soldiers marching out to war at the break of every morning
Many mourners weeping in their sackcloth and ashes through all of the gates
Busy merchants buying and selling all of their wares in the crowded markets
questions.answer: Old men and women sitting in the streets, and boys and girls playing in them

questions.question: Zechariah 8 says many peoples and nations will come to seek the LORD in Jerusalem.
Jerusalem shall be called the faithful _____, and the mountain of the LORD of hosts, the holy mountain.
Speak the _____ to one another; render true and peaceful judgments in your gates.
